Reviewer: uma pool job review-4470, GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Needs changes before merge. This is a SAFETY-tier review. I found three blockers in the source.

Requested before merge:

1. **P1 — Removed motion can hide a collision.** `crates/app/src/nc_sim/mod.rs:210-214` replaces the first straight move with a point. This also removes a move from a caller-supplied `Dialect::initial_position`. For example, set the start to `(-10, 0, 10)`. Put a fixture across X=0 and command the first rapid to `(10, 0, 10)`. The real traverse crosses the fixture. The checked point at X=10 does not. The report can return clean. The note does not prevent this result. Preserve a known start position. For an unknown start, refuse the unjudged approach or return a result that cannot be clean. Use one input rule for straight moves and arcs. Add tests for a first rapid across a fixture and a first feed across the target, with clear endpoints.

2. **P1 — Unsupported cutter tips can pass the tool map.** `crates/app/src/nc_sim/tools.rs:103-106` accepts every sane `Taper`. A flat or ball taper tip can be sane. However, `atom` at line 160 models every taper as a sharp cone. `checks::verify_sections` also calls `Cutter::of`, which does not read `tip_form`. For a 90-degree taper with a 2 mm flat tip, the real radius at the tip is 1 mm. The checked cone radius there is zero. A cut beside that tip can gouge the target without a finding. The operation path already refuses these tools through `camcraft_tools::taper::is_unread_tip`. Apply that guard to all NC tool sources, or implement and verify the actual tip shapes. Add flat-tip and ball-tip tests. A kind allow-list alone does not close this class.

3. **P1 — The new verdict bypasses mesh-fidelity guards.** `crates/app/src/nc_sim/mod.rs:298` gets the tolerance only from `opts.tol` or `DEV_TOL`. Lines 317-340 judge the document facets without their fidelity records. `play_seed` also stores `tol: Ok(tol)` through `stock_play_nc.rs:24`. Thus a reduced-fidelity target gets no tighter check. A target or fixture of unknown fidelity gets no refusal. In particular, `fixture::steel_box` excludes the unknown sentinel from box growth; its caller must refuse that fixture. The existing `model_fidelity` laws require these checks because a faceted surface can clear a tool that hits the true surface. Add one preparation guard for the selected stock, target and fixtures. Preserve the refusal or adjusted tolerance in both simulation and playback. Add tests for reduced fidelity and unknown fidelity. An explicit tolerance must not bypass the guard.

Reviewer: local PR-reviewer (Claude Opus 5.5), mkinney host. I did not write or refresh this PR.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a SAFETY-tier re-review: the PR adds a stock simulation, gouge checks and collision checks for external NC programs. The three earlier findings are fixed. I found no new blocker. This is a `feat` PR, so it merges at the next cut.

## Earlier findings (review at `f1d91efa46`)

1. **Removed first motion can hide a collision: fixed.** Commit `7b01e1ebe` removes the first-move collapse from `crates/app/src/nc_sim/mod.rs`. `prepare` now refuses all simulation and playback when `NcSimOptions::initial_position_known` is false. The rule is the same for straight moves and arcs. The parser moves the cursor into the new frame at a work-offset change (`crates/gcode/src/frame.rs:55-77`), so the `from` point of a later section is also correct. Pins: `nc_first_rapid_crossing_fixture_is_checked_with_clear_endpoints`, `nc_first_feed_crossing_target_is_checked_with_clear_endpoints`, `nc_unknown_start_refuses_straights_and_arcs_in_simulation_and_playback`.
2. **Unsupported taper tips pass the tool map: fixed.** `geometry_problem` in `crates/app/src/nc_sim/tools.rs` applies `camcraft_tools::taper::is_unread_tip` after `resolve`. Thus the guard applies to the explicit, document and library sources. Pin: `nc_flat_and_ball_taper_tips_are_refused_from_every_tool_source`.
3. **The verdict bypasses mesh-fidelity guards: fixed.** The new `crates/app/src/nc_sim/fidelity.rs` is one guard for `simulate_nc` and `play_seed`. It refuses unknown stock, target and fixture fidelity. It tightens the tolerance from `min(requested, DEV_TOL)` by the worst excess, and it refuses when no budget remains. An explicit tolerance cannot bypass it. `play_seed` receives the same adjusted tolerance. Six fidelity pins cover this (names in the PR body).

Because no outside code is added, I built the PR.

- The runner reads the document and changes nothing, so it needs no undoable command. The MCP tool is follow-up #2220.
- The tests join the existing `stock_sim_document` suite. No new test binary.
- No UI file, snapshot PNG, golden, `.nc`, `.cl` or catalog file changed. "Goldens moved: None" agrees with the diff.
- No process file changed. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #2218`.
- New modules have provenance lines. All new files are under 400 lines.

## Optional, non-blocking

- The `initial_position_known` flag is in `NcSimOptions`, but the start point is in `ParseOptions`. A future MCP tool (#2220) can set the two from one input, so that a caller cannot confirm a start that it did not give.
